required_p1_tests.requirement: Finalized 0/1/127/128/129 paging is stable; journal-before-cursor and non-starvation failures are exact.
Snapshot isolation ignores non-finalized changes and discovers later duties on the next finalized snapshot.
due/grace, nonce 127/128/129, contiguous/gap/overlap and 256-duty admission boundaries pass.
Primary and post-grace fallback selection is deterministic across all ineligibility and tie cases.
Primary plus two distinct eligible replicas succeeds; every signature/domain/key/window negative fails without state or event.
Identical replay is side-effect-free; changed-root equivocation stores both hashes and one ineligibility transition.
Automatic polling discovers, signs, confirms, durably submits and marks publishable only after finalized success.
Peers refuse missing/corrupt/wrong-sequence/audience/duty/key/replay cases and never count or serve corrupt bytes.
All primary crash boundaries retry byte-identically with one effect; deterministic post-grace fallback completes.
Cursor/outbox survive restart and transport/decode/transaction failures retain work without empty success.
One primary plus two replicas converge, then corruption/partition drives deterministic safe promotion/repair within two 100-block intervals without weakening quorum.
